name: STORE
reason: Every entry key is prefixed with the calling tenant's profile and agent scope through tenant_key, and a SaaS call with no tenant scope gets an isolated key that never matches.

name: LIFECYCLE_GATE
reason: Serializes TinyMCP open/close transitions, which the module admits one at a time process-wide; it guards no data and carries no tenant state.

name: REGISTRY
reason: Keyed by a random per-remix correlation id; each entry holds the registering caller's config and CoreContext, which every callback re-enters. Callbacks are accepted only from the module peer (bus name owner) for a live id, and the entry is retired by End, a failed call, or an age sweep.

name: FOREGROUND
reason: Holds only unit mutexes. The key is the workspace directory, so different workspaces never share or wait on a lock and no tenant data is stored.

name: HANDLERS
reason: Host wiring: an id-keyed table of handlers the embedding host registers at startup (core::slots::HookSlot). It holds code, never tenant data; a per-context override table lives on the CoreContext, not here.

name: RUNTIME
reason: The single tinybus module bus (broker, loader, connection) for the process; tinybus never unloads a module, so there is exactly one. Carries no tenant data: tenant scope is resolved per call by the host callbacks it serves.

name: CALLBACKS
reason: Records that the host callback objects were served on the module bus once, before any module loads; infrastructure only.

name: REPORTER
reason: Deduplicates terminal module outcomes per (module id, reason) so a broken install is one Sentry event per process; keys are registry ids only and no tenant data is held.

name: TABLE
reason: The compiled module registry in the shape the tinybus resolver consumes; constants only.

name: LOGGED
reason: Registry ids whose serving source was already logged, so each is logged once; holds static ids only.

name: TEST_PARK_AFTER_RUN
reason: A debug/test-only hook flag (`cfg(any(test, debug_assertions))`) that parks `run_chat_task` after its run so the idle guard can be exercised end to end; it holds no tenant data and is off unless a test sets it.

name: ROUTE_TURN
reason: Test-only (cfg(test)): serializes each TinyConnectors call with the route it sets, because libtest runs a crate's tests in one process and the module's route is process-global; it guards no data and carries no tenant state.

name: OPEN_WORKSPACE_STORES
reason: Holds open the workspace transcript stores used when no host session store is installed. Each entry is a handle to the SQLite store under one workspace, keyed by that workspace and the session store key (agent_key_for: <profile>~<agent> for a SaaS profile), so two profiles or agents never share an entry; the store under the workspace is the authoritative data. release_workspace_defaults drops them all for a data reset, release_workspace those of one workspace.

name: PROCESS
reason: The process's registry of weak handles to the rebindable session-store providers a host installed, so a workspace switch (storage::rebind) can point each at the new backend. It holds no records and no tenant state, only Weak references; the stores' data lives in the storage backend. A test builds its own StoreRegistry, so rebinding one never moves another's stores.

name: TEST_GLOBALS
reason: cfg(test) only: replaces a slot's process table with a per-thread one so a test's fake registration cannot reach a test on another thread. Not compiled into any shipped build.

name: ARTIFACT_ROW_HANDLE
reason: Keeps the one process-wide event-bus subscription that writes artifact rows alive and makes registration idempotent; it holds no data, and each event names the workspace and thread its row is written to.

name: ROOT_HOSTED_HARNESS
reason: One unconfigured harness is process infrastructure; per-invocation models, tools, middleware, progress, and host capabilities are supplied through each invocation, so the singleton carries no tenant authority or data.

name: GLOBAL
reason: The process registry is operator configuration in single-user hosts; SaaS startup installs built-ins only and refuses workspace or home overrides, so it cannot carry one SaaS profile's definitions into another.

name: REPORT_CACHE
reason: Each cache key includes the dispatch tenant (profile and agent), requested agent id, workspace, and config path; the serialized-config fingerprint only validates freshness within that scope.

name: TEST_OVERRIDE
reason: This cfg(test) thread-local override substitutes an explicitly constructed in-memory document store for one test thread; it is test instrumentation and is not installed in production builds.

name: GATE
reason: The process gate is infrastructure, and its waiter, parked-review, and thread lookup tables use the profile-only tenant key plus request/thread id; agent requests remain available to their profile-level UI while other profiles cannot reach them.

name: PROVIDER
reason: The installed provider is a routing handle to the session storage backend; callers select AgentStores with the authenticated tenant's session_key, and durable records remain in the backend.

name: FALLBACKS
reason: Each entry routes one workspace path to its storage backend and DriverSessionStores provider; returned stores still require the caller's tenant session key, while authoritative session data remains in the backend.

name: MEMORY
reason: The in-memory provider is a workspace-keyed fallback routing handle; its AgentStores are selected with the caller's tenant session key, and an unusable workspace cannot read another workspace's provider.

name: TRIAGE_MONOTONIC_START
reason: Provides one monotonic millisecond epoch for provider/model outage-breaker timestamps across all calls in the process; it stores no tenant or trigger data.

name: TRIAGE_RETRY_STATE
reason: This process-wide retry table stores only outage counters, timestamps, and in-flight flags keyed by provider name and model; it holds no trigger payload or tenant record, and deliberately shares provider health backoff.

name: TEST_EVENTS
reason: This cfg(test)-only recorder captures trigger events emitted by unit-test fixtures so assertions can inspect helper output; it is absent from production builds and is not an application event store.

name: EMBEDDER_POST_TURN_HOOKS
reason: Embedder post-turn hooks are intentionally registered process-wide as host defaults; per-agent and per-turn hooks live in CoreContext host overrides, and this registry does not store tenant identifiers or per-agent callback entries.

name: EMBEDDER_TOOL_HOOKS
reason: Embedder tool hooks are intentionally process-wide host defaults; per-agent and per-turn hooks live in CoreContext host overrides, and each invocation receives its own OpenHumanRunContext rather than registry-held tenant state.

name: SKIP_LOGGED
reason: This process-wide latch suppresses duplicate informational messages when Langfuse pushes are disabled for an environment; it stores no request, credential, or tenant data.

name: ENGINE
reason: The command-hook engine is process-wide configuration and infrastructure shared by runtimes; per-call execution receives a DispatchCtx, while no tenant data is retained in the engine handle.
verification: hooks/README.md: configured command HookEngine is installed for the process

name: EMPTY_TOOLS
reason: This immutable empty slice is a construction sentinel for a static safety-section PromptContext; it carries no prompt or tenant data.

name: EMPTY_WORKFLOWS
reason: This immutable empty slice is a construction sentinel for a static safety-section PromptContext; it carries no workflow or tenant data.

name: EMPTY_INTEGRATIONS
reason: This immutable empty slice is a construction sentinel for a static safety-section PromptContext; it carries no integration or tenant data.

name: EMPTY_VISIBLE
reason: This once-initialized empty set is the immutable visibility sentinel used by the static safety-section PromptContext; no agent or tenant-specific tool names are inserted.

name: POOL
reason: This process-local router cache is keyed by RouterScope (authenticated profile key plus workspace path); each router retains the matching driver's storage scope, and storage opens run under that explicit context.

name: STORES
reason: Test-only store overrides use the same profile-and-workspace RouterScope key as the production router cache, so test fixtures cannot cross profile or workspace boundaries.

name: LEASES
reason: Each in-flight delivery lease key combines the calling profile key with its thread id; it stores only active per-thread exclusion keys and no completion contents.

name: SUPERVISOR
reason: The process-local supervisor holds generation cancellation handles keyed by run id, not durable workflow state or tenant data. Durable run transitions remain fenced by the storage driver's revision and lease checks.

name: CLIENTS
reason: The canonical TinyMCP client table is keyed by the resolved agent directory. Host completion and exact-client eviction preserve the same directory fence across close and purge; no runtime guard is retained in the table.

name: LAST_RESOLUTION
reason: The inbound event queues' configuration (queue manifest, pipeline, queue backend) resolved from [inbound] when the process-wide tinyeventqueues module is loaded; the storage host reads it to grant the module's queues. It is process configuration for the one module instance and carries no tenant data.

name: SHIPPED
reason: The module's shipped queues.json and pipeline.json, parsed once; immutable process configuration with no tenant data.

name: CHECKPOINTS
reason: Keyed by the config file path the dispatch context loaded, so a checkpoint (the prior local_ai section, including its key) is only ever restored into the config it was taken from; one entry per config, replaced by the next checkpointed save and removed by its rollback.
